out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces Effectively Washed
violations.observation: Kitchen equipment and utensils was observed ineffectively cleaned by (manual, mechanical) warewashing. EHS observed 3 compartment sink (actively being used) set up with as: wash, sanitize (with chlorine), rinse.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food contact surfaces and utensils shall be effectively washed to remove or completely loosen soils by using the manual or mechanical means necessary such as the application of detergents containing wetting agents and emulsifiers; acid, alkaline, or abrasive cleaners; hot water; brushes; scouring pads; high-pressure sprays; or ultrasonic devices. The washing procedures selected shall be based on the type and purpose of the equipment or utensil and on the type of soil to be removed. CDI: EHS educated CFM on proper order of wash, rinse, sanitize at 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: 1) OPENED PACKAGES OF HUMMUS, SALSA, PIZZA SAUCE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DATE THE OPENED PACKAGES OF COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED FOODS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION FOR THE SECOND SEASONAL INSPECTION IN JULY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed cans of home use pesticides stored in the mop sink of the snack bar.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD ANY HOME USE PESTICIDES. IF A PEST ISSUE NEEDS TREATMENT, STAFF SHALL BE CONTACTING A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE SECOND SEASONAL INSPECTION IN JULY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed canned beverages and fryer oil in direct contact with the floor in the snack bar.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT NOTHING SHALL BE DIRECTLY STORED ON THE FLOOR. ELEVATE ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR BY 6 INCHES USING NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT SEASONAL INSPECTION IN JULY.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean equipment on shelving above the 3-vat sink were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STORE ALL CLEANED EQUIPMENT ON SHELVES UPSIDE DOWN. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE SECOND SEASONAL INSPECTION IN JULY.
